faults.name: stale-details-after-search
faults.caughtAs: Details still show a place that the search hides

faults.name: map-buttons-not-filtered
faults.caughtAs: The map still offers a button for a place the filter hides

faults.name: search-replaces-category
faults.caughtAs: Missing visible content: No places found

faults.name: category-ignores-search
faults.caughtAs: Search text that is still shown is ignored after choosing a category

faults.name: outdoors-filter-ignored
faults.caughtAs: The Outdoors filter lists an indoor place

faults.name: notes-after-cleared-selection
faults.caughtAs: Place notes still name a place whose selection was cleared

faults.name: list-not-keyboard-reachable
faults.caughtAs: Keyboard users cannot reach North garden through the list

variants.name: select-buttons-in-rows
variants.why: Each list row is a title in a span followed by a Select button that belongs to the row.

variants.name: radio-list
variants.why: Each list row is a labelled radio button, reached with the keyboard and chosen with Space.

variants.name: numbered-map-names
variants.why: Map buttons are named by number and place alone, such as 2: Paper house, without a verb.

variants.name: map-groups
variants.why: Each map button is named Select and belongs to a group that shows the place name.

variants.name: numbered-detail-title
variants.why: The detail area shows the place name inside a longer heading, such as 2 · Paper house.

variants.name: alternate-names
variants.why: Other usual names: the regions are Map of small places, Place list and Detail area, and the dialog opener is Open place notes.

variants.name: numbered-list-rows
variants.why: Each list row reads "1. North garden" in one text of its own, directly followed by a Select button, and the list ends with a row about a place that is not open yet, North gardeners' shed, whose name only begins like North garden.
